forum.title: The slave device of IIC is unable to raise the SCL response.
forum.best_answer_content:
I'm aware of all of this. The cause of the problem lies in the usage issue of the HAL\_I2C\_Slave\_Seq\_Receive\_IT interface.

The received byte count must be the same as the number sent by the host.

Adding or subtracting just one byte will cause the system to enter the ER interrupt.
